verdict.rationale: OpenHands Enterprise is documented as providing commercial capabilities and support for organizations that need licensed self-hosting or managed deployment. The pricing page lists Enterprise SAML/SSO, and OpenHands Cloud is offered as a managed commercial service. All three elements of the story are claimed, but only as single-line vendor statements. Missing for 10: details of enterprise licensing terms or pricing, specifics of the support offering (SLAs, tiers), org-wide admin and seat-management capabilities, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
